ch_vocab_b1_01.title: Work & Office Life
ch_vocab_b1_01.theory:
## Work and Office Vocabulary

At the B1 level, you need to talk about your professional life, describe your job, and understand workplace interactions.

### Key Job Vocabulary
| Spanish | English |
|---|---|
| **el jefe / la jefa** | boss |
| **el empleado / la empleada** | employee |
| **la empresa** | company |
| **el sueldo / el salario** | salary / wages |
| **la reunión** | meeting |
| **el contrato** | contract |
| **el horario** | schedule |
| **las horas extra** | overtime |
| **el puesto** | position / job |
| **la entrevista** | interview |
| **el currículum (vitae)** | résumé / CV |

### Important Work الأفعال
| Spanish | English |
|---|---|
| **contratar** | to hire |
| **despedir** | to fire |
| **renunciar / dimitir** | to resign / quit |
| **solicitar un empleo** | to apply for a job |
| **jubilarse** | to retire |

### Work Expressions
- **Trabajar a tiempo completo** — to work full-الوقت
- **Trabajar a tiempo parcial** — to work part-الوقت
- **Estar en paro / desempleado** — to be unemployed
- **Hacer una entrevista** — to have an interview
- **Firmar un contrato** — to sign a contract
- **Pedir un aumento** — to ask for a raise

### Talking About Your Job
- **Trabajo en una empresa de tecnología.** — I work at a tech company.
- **Mi horario es de 9 a 5.** — My schedule is 9 to 5.
- **Tengo reunión a las tres.** — I have a meeting at three.
- **Estoy buscando trabajo.** — I am looking for a job.
- **Me despidieron el mes pasado.** — I was fired last month.
key_points: el sueldo/salario = salary, el puesto = position, la empresa = company
contratar = hire, despedir = fire, renunciar/dimitir = resign
Trabajar a tiempo completo/parcial = work full-time/part-time
Estar en paro/desempleado = to be unemployed

vocab_list.example: Trabajo en una empresa internacional.
vocab_list.example_meaning: I work at an international company.

vocab_list.example: Mi sueldo no es muy alto.
vocab_list.example_meaning: My salary is not very high.

vocab_list.example: Tenemos una reunión a las diez.
vocab_list.example_meaning: We have a meeting at ten.

vocab_list.example: La empresa va a contratar a veinte personas.
vocab_list.example_meaning: The company is going to hire twenty people.

vocab_list.example: Envié mi currículum a tres empresas.
vocab_list.example_meaning: I sent my résumé to three companies.

ch_vocab_b1_02.title: Education & مدرسة System
ch_vocab_b1_02.theory:
## Education and مدرسة System Vocabulary

Understanding the Spanish education system and being able to discuss academic life is essential at the B1 level.

### The Spanish Education System
| Stage | Spanish | Ages |
|---|---|---|
| Preschool | **la educación infantil** | 0–6 |
| Primary | **la educación primaria** | 6–12 |
| Secondary | **la educación secundaria (ESO)** | 12–16 |
| High مدرسة | **el bachillerato** | 16–18 |
| University | **la universidad** | 18+ |

### Academic Vocabulary
| Spanish | English |
|---|---|
| **la carrera / el grado** | university degree |
| **la beca** | scholarship |
| **la matrícula** | enrollment / tuition |
| **la nota / la calificación** | grade / mark |
| **el título** | diploma / degree |
| **la asignatura** | subject (مدرسة) |
| **el semestre** | semester |
| **el examen** | exam |

### Key Academic الأفعال
| Spanish | English |
|---|---|
| **aprobar** | to pass (an exam) |
| **suspender** | to fail (an exam) |
| **graduarse** | to graduate |
| **investigar** | to research |
| **matricularse** | to enroll |

### Useful Expressions
- **Estudiar una carrera** — to study a degree (at university)
- **Sacarse el título** — to earn your degree
- **Aprobar / suspender un examen** — to pass / fail an exam
- **Sacar buenas / malas notas** — to get جيد / bad grades
- **Pedir una beca** — to apply for a scholarship

### Example Sentences
- **Estudio Derecho en la Universidad de Salamanca.** — I study Law at the University of Salamanca.
- **Aprobé todos los exámenes del semestre.** — I passed all the semester exams.
- **Me gradué el año pasado.** — I graduated last year.
key_points: Spanish system: primaria → secundaria (ESO) → bachillerato → universidad
aprobar = to pass, suspender = to fail (an exam)
la carrera/grado = degree, la beca = scholarship, la matrícula = tuition
Sacarse el título = to earn your degree, sacar buenas notas = get good grades

vocab_list.example: ¿Qué carrera estudias?
vocab_list.example_meaning: What degree are you studying?

vocab_list.example: Aprobé el examen de matemáticas.
vocab_list.example_meaning: I passed the math exam.

vocab_list.example: Suspendí historia, tengo que repetir.
vocab_list.example_meaning: I failed history, I have to retake it.

vocab_list.example: Conseguí una beca para estudiar en el extranjero.
vocab_list.example_meaning: I got a scholarship to study abroad.

vocab_list.example: Se graduó con las mejores notas de su clase.
vocab_list.example_meaning: She graduated with the best grades in her class.

ch_vocab_b1_03.title: Environment & Ecology
ch_vocab_b1_03.theory:
## Environment and Ecology Vocabulary

Environmental topics are frequently discussed in B1-level conversations and exams. Learn the key vocabulary to talk about ecological issues.

### Core Environmental Vocabulary
| Spanish | English |
|---|---|
| **el medio ambiente** | the environment |
| **la contaminación** | pollution |
| **el reciclaje** | recycling |
| **el cambio climático** | climate change |
| **el calentamiento global** | global warming |
| **la energía renovable** | renewable energy |
| **la energía solar** | solar energy |
| **la naturaleza** | nature |
| **el ecosistema** | ecosystem |
| **la deforestación** | deforestation |
| **las emisiones** | emissions |
| **la sostenibilidad** | sustainability |

### Environmental الأفعال
| Spanish | English |
|---|---|
| **reciclar** | to recycle |
| **contaminar** | to pollute |
| **proteger** | to protect |
| **reducir** | to reduce |
| **reutilizar** | to reuse |
| **ahorrar (energía/agua)** | to save (energy/water) |

### Recycling Categories
- **Reciclar papel y cartón** — Recycle paper and cardboard
- **Reciclar vidrio** — Recycle glass
- **Reciclar plástico** — Recycle plastic
- **Contenedor amarillo** — Plastics and cans
- **Contenedor azul** — Paper and cardboard
- **Contenedor verde** — Glass

### Useful Expressions
- **Proteger el medio ambiente** — to protect the environment
- **Reducir las emisiones de CO2** — to reduce CO2 emissions
- **La contaminación del aire / del agua** — air / water pollution
- **Usar transporte público** — to use public transport
- **Debemos cuidar el planeta.** — We must take care of the planet.
- **El cambio climático es un problema global.** — Climate change is a global مشكلة.
key_points: el medio ambiente = environment, la contaminación = pollution
reciclar, reducir, reutilizar — the three R's of sustainability
el cambio climático = climate change, el calentamiento global = global warming
Proteger el medio ambiente = to protect the environment

vocab_list.example: Debemos proteger el medio ambiente.
vocab_list.example_meaning: We must protect the environment.

vocab_list.example: La contaminación del aire es un problema serio.
vocab_list.example_meaning: Air pollution is a serious مشكلة.

vocab_list.example: En mi casa reciclamos papel, vidrio y plástico.
vocab_list.example_meaning: At my منزل we recycle paper, glass, and plastic.

vocab_list.example: El cambio climático afecta a todo el planeta.
vocab_list.example_meaning: Climate change affects the entire planet.

vocab_list.example: España invierte mucho en energía renovable.
vocab_list.example_meaning: Spain invests a lot in renewable energy.

ch_vocab_b1_04.title: Media & News
ch_vocab_b1_04.theory:
## Media and News Vocabulary

At the B1 level, you should be able to discuss current events, understand news reports, and talk about different media types.

### Types of Media
| Spanish | English |
|---|---|
| **los medios de comunicación** | media |
| **el periódico** | newspaper |
| **la revista** | magazine |
| **la cadena de televisión** | TV channel / network |
| **la radio** | radio |
| **la prensa** | the press |
| **las redes sociales** | social media |
| **la publicidad** | advertising |
| **el anuncio** | advertisement |

### News Vocabulary
| Spanish | English |
|---|---|
| **las noticias** | the news |
| **el artículo** | article |
| **el titular** | headline |
| **la entrevista** | interview |
| **la opinión** | opinion |
| **el/la periodista** | journalist |
| **el reportaje** | report / feature story |
| **la fuente** | source |

### News الأفعال
| Spanish | English |
|---|---|
| **publicar** | to publish |
| **informar** | to inform / report |
| **entrevistar** | to interview |
| **opinar** | to give an opinion |
| **investigar** | to investigate |

### Useful Expressions
- **Según el artículo...** — According to the article...
- **He leído en el periódico que...** — I read in the newspaper that...
- **Las últimas noticias** — the latest news
- **Las redes sociales influyen mucho en la opinión pública.** — Social media greatly influences public opinion.
- **¿Has visto las noticias hoy?** — Have you seen the news today?
- **El titular del periódico dice que...** — The newspaper headline says that...

### Discussion Phrases
- **En mi opinión, la prensa debería ser más objetiva.** — In my opinion, the press should be more objective.
- **No todo lo que se publica es verdad.** — Not everything that is published is true.
key_points: los medios de comunicación = media, la prensa = the press
el periódico = newspaper, la revista = magazine, las redes sociales = social media
publicar = to publish, informar = to report, el titular = headline
Según el artículo... = According to the article...

vocab_list.example: ¿Has visto las noticias de hoy?
vocab_list.example_meaning: Have you seen today's news?

vocab_list.example: Leo el periódico todas las mañanas.
vocab_list.example_meaning: I read the newspaper every morning.

vocab_list.example: Paso demasiado tiempo en las redes sociales.
vocab_list.example_meaning: I spend too much الوقت on social media.

vocab_list.example: El periodista publicó un artículo muy interesante.
vocab_list.example_meaning: The journalist published a very مثير للاهتمام article.

vocab_list.example: Vi un anuncio de trabajo en Internet.
vocab_list.example_meaning: I saw a job advertisement on the Internet.

ch_vocab_b1_05.title: Culture & Arts
ch_vocab_b1_05.theory:
## Culture and Arts Vocabulary

Discussing culture, art, and artistic expression is an important part of B1-level Spanish. This vocabulary allows you to talk about museums, literature, and cultural events.

### Art and Museum Vocabulary
| Spanish | English |
|---|---|
| **el museo** | museum |
| **la galería** | gallery |
| **la exposición** | exhibition |
| **la obra de arte** | work of art |
| **el cuadro / la pintura** | painting |
| **la escultura** | sculpture |
| **la arquitectura** | architecture |
| **el patrimonio cultural** | cultural heritage |

### People in the Arts
| Spanish | English |
|---|---|
| **el escritor / la escritora** | writer |
| **el autor / la autora** | author |
| **el pintor / la pintora** | painter |
| **el escultor / la escultora** | sculptor |
| **el director / la directora** | director |
| **el músico / la música** | musician |

### Literary Vocabulary
| Spanish | English |
|---|---|
| **la novela** | novel |
| **el poema** | poem |
| **la obra de teatro** | play (theater) |
| **el cuento** | short story |
| **el ensayo** | essay |

### Types of Art
- **el arte abstracto** — abstract art
- **el arte contemporáneo** — contemporary art
- **el arte clásico** — classical art
- **la fotografía** — photography

### Useful Expressions
- **Ir a una exposición** — to go to an exhibition
- **La obra de Picasso** — Picasso's work
- **El patrimonio de la humanidad** — World Heritage (UNESCO)
- **Me encanta el arte contemporáneo.** — I حب contemporary art.
- **Esta novela fue escrita por García Márquez.** — This novel was written by García Márquez.
- **El Museo del Prado tiene una colección impresionante.** — The Prado Museum has an impressive collection.
key_points: el museo = museum, la galería = gallery, la exposición = exhibition
el cuadro/la pintura = painting, la escultura = sculpture
la novela = novel, el poema = poem, la obra de teatro = play
el patrimonio cultural = cultural heritage, el patrimonio de la humanidad = World Heritage

vocab_list.example: Visitamos el Museo del Prado en Madrid.
vocab_list.example_meaning: We visited the Prado Museum in Madrid.

vocab_list.example: Hay una exposición de Frida Kahlo este mes.
vocab_list.example_meaning: There is a Frida Kahlo exhibition this month.

vocab_list.example: Estoy leyendo una novela de Isabel Allende.
vocab_list.example_meaning: I am reading a novel by Isabel Allende.

vocab_list.example: Este cuadro fue pintado en el siglo XVII.
vocab_list.example_meaning: This painting was painted in the 17th century.

vocab_list.example: Fuimos a ver una obra de teatro el sábado.
vocab_list.example_meaning: We went to see a play on السبت.

ch_vocab_b1_06.title: المشاعر
ch_vocab_b1_06.theory:
## Relationships and Emotions — Advanced Vocabulary

At the B1 level, you move beyond basic feelings and learn to describe complex relationships, emotional states, and interpersonal dynamics.

### Relationship Stages
| Spanish | English |
|---|---|
| **conocerse** | to meet / get to know each other |
| **salir (con alguien)** | to go out (with someone) / to date |
| **enamorarse (de)** | to fall in حب (with) |
| **ser novios** | to be boyfriend/girlfriend |
| **casarse (con)** | to get married (to) |
| **divorciarse** | to get divorced |
| **romper (con)** | to break up (with) |
| **separarse** | to separate |

### Relationship Vocabulary
| Spanish | English |
|---|---|
| **la pareja** | partner / couple |
| **la relación** | relationship |
| **la amistad** | friendship |
| **la confianza** | trust |
| **la boda** | wedding |

### Interpersonal الأفعال
| Spanish | English |
|---|---|
| **llevarse bien / mal (con)** | to get along well / badly (with) |
| **discutir** | to argue |
| **confiar en** | to trust (in) |
| **apoyar** | to support |
| **echar de menos** | to miss (someone) |
| **decepcionar** | to disappoint |
| **perdonar** | to forgive |

### Emotional Expressions
- **Estar enamorado/a de** — to be in حب with
- **Llevarse bien con alguien** — to get along with someone
- **Estoy muy decepcionado contigo.** — I am very disappointed in you.
- **Te echo mucho de menos.** — I miss you very much.
- **Confío plenamente en ti.** — I fully trust you.
- **Tuvimos una discusión fuerte.** — We had a big argument.
- **Le pidió perdón.** — He/She asked for forgiveness.
key_points: enamorarse de = to fall in love with, casarse con = to get married to
llevarse bien/mal con = to get along well/badly with someone
echar de menos = to miss someone, confiar en = to trust in
romper con = to break up with, divorciarse = to get divorced

vocab_list.example: Se enamoraron en la universidad.
vocab_list.example_meaning: They fell in حب at university.

vocab_list.example: Me llevo muy bien con mis compañeros de trabajo.
vocab_list.example_meaning: I get along very well with my coworkers.

vocab_list.example: Echo de menos a mi familia.
vocab_list.example_meaning: I miss my family.

vocab_list.example: Se casaron el verano pasado.
vocab_list.example_meaning: They got married last summer.

vocab_list.example: Es difícil perdonar una mentira.
vocab_list.example_meaning: It is difficult to forgive a lie.

ch_vocab_b1_07.title: Law & Rights
ch_vocab_b1_07.theory:
## Law and Rights Vocabulary

At the B1 level, you should understand basic legal concepts and be able to discuss rights, laws, and justice in Spanish.

### Core Legal Vocabulary
| Spanish | English |
|---|---|
| **la ley** | law |
| **el derecho** | right / law (as a field) |
| **el deber** | duty / obligation |
| **la justicia** | justice |
| **el juez / la jueza** | judge |
| **el abogado / la abogada** | lawyer |
| **el juicio** | trial |
| **el delito / el crimen** | crime / offense |
| **la víctima** | victim |

### Legal الصفات
| Spanish | English |
|---|---|
| **culpable** | guilty |
| **inocente** | innocent |
| **legal / ilegal** | legal / illegal |
| **justo / injusto** | fair / unfair |

### Legal الأفعال
| Spanish | English |
|---|---|
| **denunciar** | to report (a crime) / to file a complaint |
| **juzgar** | to judge / to try |
| **defender** | to defend |
| **acusar** | to accuse |
| **condenar** | to convict / to sentence |
| **absolver** | to acquit |

### Rights and Freedoms
- **los derechos humanos** — human rights
- **los derechos fundamentales** — fundamental rights
- **la libertad** — freedom / حرية
- **la igualdad** — equality
- **la Constitución** — the Constitution
- **Tener derecho a...** — to have the right to...

### Useful Expressions
- **Es un delito.** — It is a crime.
- **Todos somos iguales ante la ley.** — We are all equal before the law.
- **Tener derecho a un abogado** — to have the right to a lawyer
- **Denunciar un robo** — to report a theft
- **El juez dictó sentencia.** — The judge passed sentence.
key_points: la ley = law, el derecho = right, el deber = duty/obligation
culpable = guilty, inocente = innocent, el juicio = trial
denunciar = to report a crime, juzgar = to judge/try
Tener derecho a... = to have the right to...

vocab_list.example: Todos debemos respetar la ley.
vocab_list.example_meaning: We all must respect the law.

vocab_list.example: Necesito hablar con mi abogado.
vocab_list.example_meaning: I need to talk to my lawyer.

vocab_list.example: Denunció el robo a la policía.
vocab_list.example_meaning: He reported the theft to the police.

vocab_list.example: Los derechos humanos son universales.
vocab_list.example_meaning: Human rights are universal.

vocab_list.example: La libertad de expresión es un derecho fundamental.
vocab_list.example_meaning: Freedom of expression is a fundamental right.

ch_vocab_b1_08.title: Science & Technology
ch_vocab_b1_08.theory:
## Science and Technology Vocabulary

Science and technology are essential B1 topics. This vocabulary helps you discuss discoveries, inventions, and the impact of technology on daily life.

### Science Vocabulary
| Spanish | English |
|---|---|
| **la ciencia** | science |
| **el científico / la científica** | scientist |
| **el experimento** | experiment |
| **el descubrimiento** | discovery |
| **la investigación** | research |
| **el laboratorio** | laboratory |
| **el dato** | data / fact |
| **la teoría** | theory |
| **la hipótesis** | hypothesis |

### Technology Vocabulary
| Spanish | English |
|---|---|
| **la tecnología** | technology |
| **el invento** | invention |
| **la inteligencia artificial** | artificial intelligence |
| **el robot** | robot |
| **la aplicación (app)** | application (app) |
| **el algoritmo** | algorithm |

### Science and Tech الأفعال
| Spanish | English |
|---|---|
| **investigar** | to research / investigate |
| **descubrir** | to discover |
| **inventar** | to invent |
| **demostrar** | to demonstrate / prove |
| **desarrollar** | to develop |
| **analizar** | to analyze |

### Useful Expressions
- **Hacer un experimento** — to do an experiment
- **El avance de la tecnología** — the advance of technology
- **La inteligencia artificial va a cambiar el mundo.** — Artificial intelligence is going to change the world.
- **Los científicos descubrieron una nueva especie.** — The scientists discovered a new species.
- **Esta teoría fue demostrada en el laboratorio.** — This theory was demonstrated in the laboratory.
- **La tecnología ha mejorado nuestra vida diaria.** — Technology has improved our daily life.
key_points: la ciencia = science, el científico = scientist, la investigación = research
investigar = to research, descubrir = to discover, inventar = to invent
la inteligencia artificial = AI, el laboratorio = laboratory
demostrar = to prove, desarrollar = to develop, analizar = to analyze

vocab_list.example: La ciencia avanza muy rápido.
vocab_list.example_meaning: Science advances very quickly.

vocab_list.example: Fue un descubrimiento muy importante para la medicina.
vocab_list.example_meaning: It was a very important discovery for medicine.

vocab_list.example: Los científicos investigan una vacuna nueva.
vocab_list.example_meaning: The scientists are researching a جديد vaccine.

vocab_list.example: La inteligencia artificial ya se usa en muchos sectores.
vocab_list.example_meaning: Artificial intelligence is already used in many sectors.

vocab_list.example: ¿Quién inventó el teléfono?
vocab_list.example_meaning: Who invented the telephone?

ch_vocab_b1_09.title: Economy Basic Terms
ch_vocab_b1_09.theory:
## Basic Economic Vocabulary

At the B1 level, you should be able to understand and discuss basic economic concepts, especially those relevant to daily life and the news.

### Core Economic Terms
| Spanish | English |
|---|---|
| **la economía** | economy / economics |
| **el mercado** | market |
| **la empresa** | company / business |
| **el negocio** | business |
| **los impuestos** | taxes |
| **el presupuesto** | budget |
| **la inversión** | investment |
| **la deuda** | debt |
| **el PIB** | GDP |
| **la inflación** | inflation |
| **el desempleo** | unemployment |
| **el crecimiento** | growth |

### Economic الأفعال
| Spanish | English |
|---|---|
| **invertir** | to invest |
| **ahorrar** | to save (money) |
| **gastar** | to spend |
| **crecer** | to grow |
| **exportar / importar** | to export / import |
| **producir** | to produce |

### Key Expressions
- **La economía crece / decrece** — The economy grows / shrinks
- **Pagar impuestos** — to pay taxes
- **Hacer una inversión** — to make an investment
- **El mercado laboral** — the labor market
- **El coste de vida** — the cost of living
- **Estar en crisis** — to be in crisis

### Discussion Sentences
- **La inflación ha subido un 3% este año.** — Inflation has risen 3% this year.
- **El desempleo juvenil es un gran problema.** — Youth unemployment is a big مشكلة.
- **Es importante ahorrar para el futuro.** — It is important to save for the future.
- **La deuda pública ha aumentado.** — Public debt has increased.
- **Muchas empresas están invirtiendo en tecnología.** — Many companies are investing in technology.
key_points: la economía = economy, el mercado = market, los impuestos = taxes
invertir = invest, ahorrar = save, gastar = spend
la inflación = inflation, el desempleo = unemployment, la deuda = debt
el mercado laboral = labor market, el coste de vida = cost of living

vocab_list.example: La economía española está creciendo.
vocab_list.example_meaning: The Spanish economy is growing.

vocab_list.example: Todos los ciudadanos deben pagar impuestos.
vocab_list.example_meaning: All citizens must pay taxes.

vocab_list.example: Quiero ahorrar dinero para comprar una casa.
vocab_list.example_meaning: I want to save money to buy a منزل.

vocab_list.example: La inflación afecta al precio de los alimentos.
vocab_list.example_meaning: Inflation affects the price of food.

vocab_list.example: El desempleo ha bajado este trimestre.
vocab_list.example_meaning: Unemployment has dropped this quarter.

ch_vocab_b1_10.title: Opinions & Debate Expressions
ch_vocab_b1_10.theory:
## Opinion and Debate Expressions

Expressing and defالنهاية opinions is a crucial B1 skill. These expressions help you participate in discussions, agree or disagree politely, and structure your arguments.

### Expressing Opinions
| Spanish | English |
|---|---|
| **en mi opinión** | in my opinion |
| **creo que** | I think that |
| **me parece que** | it seems to me that |
| **desde mi punto de vista** | from my point of view |
| **para mí** | for me / in my view |
| **considero que** | I consider that |

### Agreeing and Disagreeing
| Spanish | English |
|---|---|
| **estoy de acuerdo (con)** | I agree (with) |
| **estoy en desacuerdo** | I disagree |
| **tienes razón** | you are right |
| **no estoy seguro/a** | I am not sure |
| **depende** | it depends |

### Connectors for Argumentation
| Spanish | English |
|---|---|
| **sin embargo** | however |
| **por un lado... por otro lado** | on one يد... on the other يد |
| **además** | moreover / furthermore |
| **por lo tanto** | therefore |
| **en conclusión** | in conclusion |
| **aunque** | although |
| **a pesar de** | على الرغم من / in spite of |
| **sin duda** | without a doubt |
| **en primer lugar... en segundo lugar** | firstly... secondly |
| **por ejemplo** | for example |

### Structuring an Argument
1. **Introduce your opinion**: En mi opinión... / Creo que...
2. **Give reasons**: Porque... / Ya que... / Debido a que...
3. **Add arguments**: Además... / También... / Por un lado...
4. **Counter-argument**: Sin embargo... / Aunque... / A pesar de...
5. **Conclude**: En conclusión... / Por lo tanto... / En resumen...

### Polite Disagreement
- **Entiendo tu punto de vista, pero...** — I understand your point of view, but...
- **Respeto tu opinión, sin embargo...** — I respect your opinion, however...
- **No estoy del todo de acuerdo porque...** — I don't fully agree because...
key_points: creo que / me pهيce que / en mi opinión — expressing opinions
estoy de acuerdo / en desacuerdo — agreeing / disagreeing
sin embargo = however, además = moreover, por lo tanto = therefore
Structure: opinion → reasons → counter-argument → conclusion

vocab_list.example: En mi opinión, la educación es lo más importante.
vocab_list.example_meaning: In my opinion, education is the most important thing.

vocab_list.example: Es caro; sin embargo, merece la pena.
vocab_list.example_meaning: It is expensive; however, it is worth it.

vocab_list.example: Estoy totalmente de acuerdo contigo.
vocab_list.example_meaning: I totally agree with you.

vocab_list.example: Es inteligente y, además, muy trabajador.
vocab_list.example_meaning: He is intelligent and, moreover, very hardworking.

vocab_list.example: No estudió, por lo tanto suspendió el examen.
vocab_list.example_meaning: He didn't study, therefore he failed the exam.

ch_vocab_b1_11.title: Health & Medicine (Advanced)
ch_vocab_b1_11.theory:
## Health and Medicine — Advanced Vocabulary

At the B1 level, you go beyond basic health vocabulary to discuss hospital visits, medical procedures, and the healthcare system.

### Hospital and Medical Vocabulary
| Spanish | English |
|---|---|
| **la operación / la cirugía** | operation / surgery |
| **el tratamiento** | treatment |
| **el diagnóstico** | diagnosis |
| **la urgencia / urgencias** | emergency / ER |
| **la ambulancia** | ambulance |
| **el especialista** | specialist |
| **la alergia** | allergy |
| **el análisis de sangre** | blood test |
| **la radiografía** | X-ray |
| **la vacuna** | vaccine |
| **el síntoma** | symptom |
| **la receta (médica)** | prescription |

### Medical الصفات
| Spanish | English |
|---|---|
| **crónico/a** | chronic |
| **agudo/a** | acute |
| **grave** | serious |
| **leve** | mild |
| **contagioso/a** | contagious |

### Medical الأفعال
| Spanish | English |
|---|---|
| **recuperarse** | to recover |
| **ingresar (en el hospital)** | to be admitted (to hospital) |
| **operar** | to operate |
| **recetar** | to prescribe |
| **vacunarse** | to get vaccinated |
| **hacerse un análisis** | to get a test done |

### Describing Symptoms to the Doctor
- **Me duele mucho la espalda desde hace una semana.** — My back has been hurting a lot for a week.
- **Tengo alergia al polen.** — I am allergic to pollen.
- **Me han hecho un análisis de sangre.** — They did a blood test on me.
- **El médico me ha recetado antibióticos.** — The doctor prescribed me antibiotics.
- **Tuve que ir a urgencias.** — I had to go to the ER.

### The Healthcare System
- **el sistema sanitario** — the healthcare system
- **la seguridad social** — social security / public health insurance
- **el médico de cabecera** — general practitioner (GP)
- **pedir cita** — to make an appointment
- **la lista de espera** — waiting list
key_points: la operación/cirugía = surgery, el tratamiento = treatment, el diagnóstico = diagnosis
crónico = chronic, agudo = acute, grave = serious, leve = mild
recuperarse = to recover, ingresar = to be admitted, vacunarse = to get vaccinated
el médico de cabecera = GP, pedir cita = to make an appointment

vocab_list.example: El tratamiento dura tres meses.

vocab_list.example: Se está recuperando de la operación.

vocab_list.example_meaning: They took him to the ER by ambulance.

ch_vocab_b1_12.title: Cooking & Recipes
ch_vocab_b1_12.theory:
## Cooking and Recipe Vocabulary

Cooking vocabulary is essential for understanding recipes, ordering food, and talking about Spanish cuisine at the B1 level.

### Cooking الأفعال
| Spanish | English |
|---|---|
| **hervir** | to boil |
| **freír** | to fry |
| **asar** | to roast / grill |
| **hornear** | to bake |
| **mezclar** | to mix |
| **cortar** | to cut |
| **pelar** | to peel |
| **picar** | to chop / mince |
| **añadir** | to add |
| **remover** | to stir |
| **calentar** | to heat up |
| **enfriar** | to cool down |

### Kitchen Equipment
| Spanish | English |
|---|---|
| **la sartén** | frying pan |
| **la olla** | pot |
| **el horno** | oven |
| **la cuchara** | spoon |
| **la cucharada** | tablespoon (measure) |
| **el cuchillo** | knife |
| **la tabla de cortar** | cutting board |

### Recipe Instructions
- **A fuego lento** — on low heat
- **A fuego fuerte** — on high heat
- **Durante 20 minutos** — for 20 minutes
- **Hasta que esté dorado** — until golden
- **Dejar reposar** — to let it rest

### Writing a Recipe — Structure
1. **Primero**, corta las verduras en trozos pequeños.
2. **Luego**, calienta aceite de oliva en una sartén.
3. **Después**, añade las verduras y fríe a fuego medio.
4. **A continuación**, añade sal y pimienta al gusto.
5. **Finalmente**, sirve caliente.

### Famous Spanish Dishes
- **la paella** — rice dish from Valencia
- **la tortilla española** — Spanish potato omelet
- **el gazpacho** — cold tomato soup
- **las croquetas** — croquettes
- **el cocido** — chickpea stew
key_points: hervir = boil, freír = fry, asar = roast, hornear = bake
cortar = cut, pelar = peel, picar = chop, añadir = add, mezclar = mix
la sartén = frying pan, la olla = pot, el horno = oven
a fuego lento/fuerte = on low/high heat, la cucharada = tablespoon

vocab_list.example: Hierve el agua antes de añadir la pasta.
vocab_list.example_meaning: Boil the water before adding the pasta.

vocab_list.example: Fríe las patatas en aceite de oliva.

ch_vocab_b1_13.title: Housing & Moving
ch_vocab_b1_13.theory:
## Housing and Moving Vocabulary

Finding a place to live and moving are practical B1-level topics. This vocabulary covers renting, buying, and everything related to housing in Spain.

### Types of Housing
| Spanish | English |
|---|---|
| **el piso / el apartamento** | apartment / flat |
| **la casa** | منزل |
| **el estudio** | studio apartment |
| **el ático** | penthouse / attic apartment |
| **el chalet / la casa adosada** | detached / semi-detached منزل |

### Renting and Buying
| Spanish | English |
|---|---|
| **alquilar** | to rent |
| **comprar** | to buy |
| **la hipoteca** | mortgage |
| **el alquiler** | rent (payment) |
| **el propietario / el dueño** | owner / landlord |
| **el inquilino / la inquilina** | tenant |
| **el contrato de alquiler** | rental contract / lease |
| **la fianza** | deposit / security deposit |
| **los gastos** | expenses / utility costs |

### Moving Vocabulary
| Spanish | English |
|---|---|
| **mudarse** | to move (منزل) |
| **la mudanza** | the move |
| **reformar** | to renovate |
| **amueblar** | to furnish |
| **amueblado / sin amueblar** | furnished / unfurnished |

### Location and Neighborhood
| Spanish | English |

| **el barrio** | neighborhood |
| **las afueras** | the outskirts / suburbs |
| **el centro** | the مدينة center |

### Useful Expressions
- **Buscar piso** — to look for an apartment
- **Firmar el contrato** — to sign the contract
- **El alquiler mensual** — the monthly rent
- **Gastos incluidos** — utilities included
- **Vivir en el centro vs las afueras** — to live in the center vs the outskirts
- **Me mudé a Barcelona el año pasado.** — I moved to Barcelona last year.
- **El piso está amueblado y tiene dos dormitorios.** — The apartment is furnished and has two bedrooms.
key_points: alquilar = to rent, el alquiler = rent (payment), la hipoteca = mortgage
el propietario/dueño = owner/landlord, el inquilino = tenant
mudarse = to move, la mudanza = the move, reformar = to renovate

ch_vocab_b1_14.title: Social Issues (Basics)
ch_vocab_b1_14.theory:
## Social Issues — Basic Vocabulary

At the B1 level, you should be able to discuss social issues and express your views on topics that affect society today.

### Core Social Issues Vocabulary
| Spanish | English |
|---|---|
| **la pobreza** | poverty |
| **la desigualdad** | inequality |
| **el racismo** | racism |
| **la discriminación** | discrimination |
| **la inmigración** | immigration |
| **el refugiado / la refugiada** | refugee |
| **la exclusión social** | social exclusion |
| **la violencia** | violence |
| **la integración** | integration |

### Social Action Vocabulary
| Spanish | English |
|---|---|
| **el voluntariado** | volunteering |
| **la ONG** | NGO (non-governmental organization) |
| **solidario/a** | supportive / charitable |
| **colaborar** | to collaborate / contribute |
| **donar** | to donate |
| **ayudar** | to help |
| **luchar (contra / por)** | to fight (against / for) |

### Rights and Values
| Spanish | English |
|---|---|
| **los derechos** | rights |
| **la igualdad** | equality |
| **la educación** | education |
| **la justicia social** | social justice |
| **la tolerancia** | tolerance |
| **el respeto** | respect |

### Key Expressions
- **La lucha contra la pobreza** — the fight against poverty
- **La igualdad de oportunidades** — equal opportunities
- **Hacer voluntariado** — to do volunteer work
- **Problemas de la sociedad actual** — problems of today's society
- **Todos merecemos las mismas oportunidades.** — We all deserve the same opportunities.
- **La discriminación es inaceptable.** — Discrimination is unacceptable.

### Discussion Sentences
- **La pobreza infantil es un problema grave en muchos países.** — Child poverty is a serious مشكلة in many countries.
- **Colaboro con una ONG que ayuda a refugiados.** — I collaborate with an NGO that helps refugees.
- **Es importante luchar por la igualdad.** — It is important to fight for equality.
- **La educación es la clave para reducir la desigualdad.** — Education is the key to reducing inequality.
key_points: la pobreza = poverty, la desigualdad = inequality, la discriminación = discrimination
el voluntariado = volunteering, la ONG = NGO, colaborar = to collaborate
la inmigración = immigration, el refugiado = refugee, la integración = integration
La lucha contra la pobreza = the fight against poverty, la igualdad de oportunidades = equal opportunities
